pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened vertices and moderate edge gradients. Patch area is maximal on the mid-flank, with geometry transitioning to smaller, more elongated shapes on the upper neck and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial connectivity. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank, narrowing slightly at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the dorsal neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth geometry. Serration peaks are distinct against the background despite low pixel resolution.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable flattening and structural discontinuity in the mane profile is visible at the transition point between the cervical and thoracic vertebrae.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized area of high-luminance textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the upper posterior flank, suggesting a chronic skin lesion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear disruption is present on the upper hindquarter, characterized by a narrow channel of missing pelage and altered skin texture intersecting several patches.
